en: A sepia-toned aerial view of a historic European city dominated by a large castle complex with a prominent Gothic cathedral featuring multiple tall spires (St. Vitus Cathedral) within a fortified area on a hill (Prague Castle). Below the hill lies a dense cluster of old town houses with tiled roofs. The image is printed on a cream card with wide margins, and beneath the photograph are captions in three languages identifying the scene.
